# neuron v0.1.2 — Windows beta

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app, CLI, and optional Chroma broker.

This build reduces idle CPU work in input dispatch, capture, audio, the tray, and previews. It also tightens Razer reply validation, device write verification, profile recovery, and integration client limits. Windows autostart runs without administrator privileges; safe mode keeps input disarmed and device writes paused. OpenGL remains the default renderer, with software and opt-in WGPU alternatives.

## Install

- **Installer:** Run `neuron-v0.1.2-windows-x86_64-setup.exe` for a per-user installation. Close a running Neuron app before updating.
- **Portable:** Extract `neuron-v0.1.2-windows-x86_64.zip` to a writable folder and run `neuron-app.exe`. Configuration stays beside the app unless `NEURON_RUN_DIR` is set.
- Native Chroma shared memory uses the bundled broker. Install it separately from a same-account administrator PowerShell using the [protocol host instructions](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL-HOST.md). Chroma REST does not need the broker.
- The Windows binaries are unsigned. Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` against the installer or ZIP; `SOURCE.txt` identifies the source commit and build method. Verify a provenance attestation if one is attached to the release.

## Limits

The v0.1.2 installer and packaged files were checked on the Windows development machine. Read-only Naga V2 Pro and BlackWidow Chroma V2 probes, native Chroma section checks, and a REST session passed. No real Chroma game frame or separate clean-machine install was tested. Linux builds from source but has no release asset; macOS has no backend. See [current status](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md) for the feature ledger and remaining hardware gates.
